acceptance: Pinned versions survive garbage collection and restart; corrupted bundle fails import without half-committed state.

positive.fixture: pins, holds, unexpired leases, kept root history, young versions and ancestors survive; a pinned version survives collection and a store restart; export then import reproduces the same bytes

negative.fixture: collector killed at every phase and finished by recovery; collection racing publishes leaves every visible manifest verifying; damaged byte or truncation at sampled offsets and re-sealed tampering refused with the store unchanged

versions.primitive: Bundle format v1; blob listings now carry the stored time; no contract change.

security_and_source_permissions: An import never moves a live channel and verifies every signature and digest before writing.
known_limitations: The publish gate is in process; a second process writing the same store must not run beside the collector
Roots, pins, holds and artifact provenance in a bundle are not signed
